snippet.title: Path of Exile 2: A Return to Oriath | Act 5 & 6 Trailer
snippet.description:
Experience the complete campaign in Path of Exile 2's full release, with the addition of Acts 5 and 6.

Return to an Oriath ravaged by countless disasters. Make your way through the horrors that await and put an end to the Twilight Order and the Beast once and for all.

Path of Exile 2 launches as a free-to-play game on December 11 (PST).

https://pathofexile2.com/fullrelease
https://pathofexile2.com/register
